paper.title_en: Nanohertz gravitational waves and asymmetric dark matter from a supercooled dark sector phase transition
paper.abstract_en: We study the connection between asymmetric dark matter and nanohertz gravitational waves from a supercooled first-order phase transition in a classically conformal dark sector. The dark sector contains a real scalar, a complex scalar and a Dirac fermion, whose mass arises from radiative symmetry breaking. An additional Affleck--Dine condensate generates a fermion asymmetry and heats the dark bath before nucleation. The conserved dark charge fixes the asymmetry between fermions and antifermions, while entropy production during delayed visible-sector reheating dilutes the relic and determines the redshift of the gravitational-wave spectrum. We calculate the thermal nucleation rate in a three-dimensional effective theory with finite-density corrections, next-to-leading-order contributions and fluctuation determinants (NLOdet). We follow the coupled thermal evolution of the dark and visible sectors. For a benchmark chosen to match the observed dark-matter abundance, the transition completes at MeV-scale temperatures and produces a nanohertz signal under the adopted dynamical and thermal assumptions. We compare the predicted collision-dominated gravitational-wave spectra with free-spectrum posteriors from pulsar timing arrays. For a benchmark point and variations of the dark-sector parameters, the gravitational-wave spectra and dark matter relic abundances are compared, and compatibility with Big Bang nucleosynthesis is assessed.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将过冷一级相变产生的纳赫兹引力波与不对称暗物质及脉冲星计时阵列观测直接关联，理论构造和成核率计算细节充分，并明确给出了热学与动力学假设、基准点以及与BBN一致性的评估，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 来自过冷暗扇区一级相变的纳赫兹引力波与不对称暗物质
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了经典共形暗扇区中过冷一级相变所产生的不对称暗物质与纳赫兹引力波之间的联系。该暗扇区包含一个实标量、一个复标量和一个狄拉克费米子，其质量来源于辐射对称性破缺。额外的 Affleck--Dine 凝聚态产生费米子不对称性，并在成核之前加热暗浴。守恒的暗荷确定了费米子与反费米子之间的不对称性，而延迟的可视扇区再加热期间的熵产生稀释了残余丰度，并决定了引力波谱的红移。我们在三维有效理论中计算热成核率，包含有限密度修正、次领头阶贡献和涨落行列式（NLOdet）。我们跟踪暗扇区与可视扇区的耦合热演化。对于选定以匹配观测到的暗物质丰度的基准点，相变在 MeV 量级温度下完成，并在所采用的动力学与热学假设下产生纳赫兹信号。我们将预测的碰撞主导引力波谱与脉冲星计时阵列的自由谱后验进行比较。对于某一基准点以及暗扇区参数的变化，我们比较了引力波谱与暗物质残余丰度，并评估了与大爆炸核合成的一致性。
